D.treatment: multicomponent educational interventions for nurse leaders

cells.quote: Two studies assessed the impact of the educational intervention on leaders' knowledge, revealing a significant difference in favor of the intervention, with a SMD of 1.05 (95% CI: 0.62, 1.48; p < 0.00001).
cells.note: The pooled evidence included one pre-post study and one randomized waitlist-controlled trial; certainty of evidence was rated low.
